title: Code-of-Practice Coverage Map: Which EU GPAI Safety Measures Have a Public Benchmark?

original_idea.body:
# Code-of-Practice Coverage Map: Which EU GPAI Safety Measures Have a Public Benchmark?

**Problem:** Bench-2-CoP asks whether benchmarks can be trusted for EU AI compliance. A complementary gap remains: a clear public map of which EU GPAI Code of Practice safety & security measures currently have any associated public benchmark, and which are purely process-based with no measurement.

**Direction:** Enumerate the Code's Safety & Security commitments, then for each, search public eval/benchmark catalogues and tag coverage (measured / partially measured / process-only / unmeasured). Produce a heatmap of measurement coverage across the Code and write up the largest unmeasured commitments.

**Why it matters:** Closes the voluntary-code-vs-enforceable-standard gap by showing exactly where the Code lacks measurement instruments, guiding where new benchmarks are most needed. Desk research on public regulatory text and benchmark lists.

**Relevant context:** EU GPAI Code of Practice (code-of-practice.ai); Bench-2-CoP (arXiv 2508.05464); COMPL-AI Framework (arXiv 2410.07959) mapping EU Act to benchmarks.
